caption: The drawing depicts an ornate handheld brush with a decorative, dark brown wooden frame and handle. The wood has a polished appearance and features elaborate carved curves and scrolls extending upward and outward from the base, forming a symmetrical, lyre-like shape. At the center of the brush's back, there is an oval area displaying a painted or embroidered scene: a person dressed in blue and white attire standing outdoors near a fence, with green grass and tan-colored elements in the background. The brush stands upright in the composition, set against a plain, cream-colored background with no additional objects or decorations. The words "HAND BRUSH" appear in small, uppercase letters near the bottom right of the image.
title: Bootjack
